original_value: This article presents an overview of fifty-eight articles dedicated to the evaluation of physical activity in free-living conditions using wearable motion sensors. This review provides a comprehensive summary of the technical aspects linked to sensors (types, number, body positions, and technical characteristics) as well as a deep discussion on the protocols implemented in free-living conditions (environment, duration, instructions, activities, and annotation). Finally, it presents a description and a comparison of the main algorithms and processing tools used for assessing physical activity from raw signals.

result.paraphrase: This article offers an overview of fifty-eight articles focused on evaluating physical activity in free-living conditions with wearable motion sensors. The review gives a comprehensive summary of sensor-related technical aspects (types, number, body placements, and technical characteristics) and a detailed discussion of the protocols used in free-living conditions (environment, duration, instructions, activities, and annotation). Finally, it describes and compares the main algorithms and processing tools used to assess physical activity from raw signals.
